// Package inventory serves the stock of a small shop over HTTP.
package inventory

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

// Item is a product on the shelves.
type Item struct {
	SKU      string    `json:"sku"`
	Name     string    `json:"name"`
	Quantity int       `json:"quantity"`
	Updated  time.Time `json:"updated"`
}

// ErrNotFound is returned for a SKU the store does not carry.
var ErrNotFound = errors.New("inventory: item not found")

// Store keeps the items in memory, safe for concurrent use.
type Store struct {
	mu    sync.RWMutex
	items map[string]Item
}

// ServeHTTP answers GET /items/{sku} with the item as JSON.
func (s *Store) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	sku := r.PathValue("sku")
	started := time.Now()
	item, err := s.Get(sku)
	if errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if err := json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(item); err != nil {
		logFailure(sku, err)
	}
	
}

// Get returns the item with the given SKU.
func (s *Store) Get(sku string) (Item, error) {
	s.mu.RLock()
	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
	item, ok := s.items[sku]
	if !ok {
		return Item{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	return item, nil
}

// Restock adds n units of an item, creating it when it is new.
func (s *Store) Restock(sku, name string, n int) Item {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	item := s.items[sku]
	item.SKU, item.Name = sku, name
	item.Quantity += n
	item.Updated = time.Now()
	s.items[sku] = item
	return item
}

// NewStore returns an empty store.
func NewStore() *Store {
	return &Store{items: make(map[string]Item)}
}
